description: The workers and labor pools behind labor planning: each worker with the account they are linked to (only a linked worker has a my-work page), the pools they qualify for, whether they are archived, and the span their calendar covers; each pool with its members. Name a worker (id or full name) to also get that worker's calendar windows that have not ended (shifts, breaks, absences, overtime). Admin; operator credentials only.

worker.description: A worker id (GUID) or full name, for that worker's calendar windows.
